("Springbok"), a Fiore-backed unlisted reporting issuer, are pleased to announce that, further to their joint press releases of October 15, 2026, October 6, 2026, September 22, 2026, September 16, 2026, August 10, 2026 and July 31, 2026, at Clean Air Metals' annual general and special meeting held on November 13, 2026 (the "Clean Air Metals Meeting") and at Springbok's annual general and special meeting held on November 13, 2026 (the "Springbok Meeting"), the shareholders of each company overwhelmingly approved the proposed three-cornered amalgamation under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia), pursuant to which Springbok and 1602037 B.C. Ltd. ("Newco"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Clean Air Metals, will amalgamate and continue as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Clean Air Metals, and, immediately following the amalgamation, each Springbok shareholder, other than a dissenting shareholder, will receive 0.9 of a post-consolidation Clean Air Metals common share for each Springbok common share held (the "Transaction").
